北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，天晴但体感很冷哦，多穿点，注意保暖防干燥！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's sunny but feels very cold. Layer up and stay hydrated!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有风，体感温度低，请注意防风保暖，别感冒了！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, cloudy and windy, it feels cold. Stay warm and watch out for the wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感温度较低，记得添衣保暖，注意防寒哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai, cloudy and chilly. Remember to add layers and stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云微凉，出门记得带件薄外套，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou, cloudy and cool. Bring a light jacket and enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen, cloudy and pleasant. Mind the temperature change between day and night.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感很低，请穿暖和些，多喝热水暖身哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou, overcast and feels very cold. Dress warmly and have some hot drinks!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，体感温度低，注意多穿衣物，别着凉了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing, sunny but cold. Remember to layer up and avoid catching a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感微凉。记得加件外套，保持温暖哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu, overcast and a bit chilly. Remember to bring a jacket and stay warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感温度低，外出务必多穿，小心着凉！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan, overcast and cold. Make sure to dress warmly when out, don't catch a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷干燥，体感温度低，注意保暖，多补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an, overcast, cold and dry. Stay warm and remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿冷，体感稍凉，记得添衣，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing, overcast, humid and a bit cool. Add layers and mind the dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -26℃！全副武装，注意防冻保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin, extremely cold with a feel of -26℃! Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -23℃，注意防寒，多喝热水暖身！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang, sunny but very cold at -23℃. Stay warm and drink hot beverages!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗风大，体感较凉。注意防风保暖，多喝水哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming, sunny and windy, feels cool. Stay warm against the wind and hydrate!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微凉，出门带件外套，保持好心情哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen, overcast and a bit cool. Bring a jacket when out and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，风力 5 级！体感极寒，务必严实保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao, cloudy with strong winds! Feels extremely cold, bundle up tight!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -17℃，非常冷，请注意防寒保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian, cloudy, feels like -17℃, very cold. Please stay warm!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
